newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia central bank delays start of repo operations.
newsitem.headline: Russia central bank delays start of repo operations.

text.p: Russia's central bank is delaying the start of repo operations until October 21 to check modifications to the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX) trading system, a senior central bank official said on Monday.
Alexei Drugov, head of the bank's securities operations department, told Reuters the final appointment of primary dealers in the government securities market would also be delayed until October 21.
The central bank will only conduct repo operations with primary dealer banks, of whom so far 22 have been named. It had previously intended to start repo operations in mid-September.
MICEX is the main trading centre for government securities.
